comment_z_rotation: Step size in degrees for Z-axis rotation sweep (360 / step = attempts per target)
comment_offsets: Offset distances in mm along negative Z of the target pose. 'before' = approach, 'after' = retract.
comment_final_pullaway: Distance in mm along negative X (red axis) from the _0 after-grab offset to create a final pullaway target per group.
comment_end_effectors: Which tool to activate when solving IK for each target type.
